covers: PF-10 (parent MST-W4-17) — serve Unity builds from R2/CDN. Fixer muse-b10, landed on v1/concordia-pf @ c86ef02bc6e5c5eabded11778f677c83d330c6a2 (parent exactly 0b9612ee8, the P0-04 landing; fire-time base-blob guard clean, eight blobs read back, P0-04 neighbour intact). Deliverables: NEW concord-frontend/lib/unity-build-url.ts — resolveUnityBuildBaseUrl (validates NEXT_PUBLIC_UNITY_BUILD_BASE_URL: http/https only, no credentials/query/hash, normalized with trailing slash, else null) + unityPlayerCandidatesFromEnv (override, then CDN base index, then the same-origin /unity-client/index.html; deduped; unset = exactly the pre-PF-10 list); concord-frontend/lib/unity-web-files.ts gains unityPayloadCompression (gzip by magic; Brotli by elimination — not gzip, not an LFS pointer, not plain text by the printable-head test; else null); the /unity-client/[...path] route sets Content-Encoding from the payload (gzip -> gzip, brotli -> br); WorldUnityShell + NativeWorldPlayer take candidates from the shared resolver; next.config.js pairs the static rule via UNITY_WEBGL_COMPRESSION (default gzip = the current export). Pins: tests/unity-build-url.test.ts (new) + tests/unity-web-files.test.ts compression cases (CI-carried). Registrar's first-hand discriminator re-run (B9, node type-stripping on the pure modules extracted from the landed commit): 16/16 on the built modules; on the pristine f4f1f77ff modules the probe dies at the two existence checks (unityPayloadCompression absent; unity-build-url.ts absent entire) — fail-before established, matching the fixer's transcript (its own harness: 13/13 built, dies at the compression checks pristine). NOT CLAIMED: post-fix step 3, the live CDN acceptance (the world lens mounting a published CDN build), is gated on Q2's durable-home naming (R2 parked) and is no part of the landed claim. Tier is the reviewer's to assign at acceptance (the fixer's draft carries it PENDING); tier 2 is entered as the proposer's form. VERIFIED waits on reviewer activation + walker replay + the Q2-gated live leg.
discriminator: Pre-fix failure transcript (fixer's premise greps + landing harness, re-run first-hand by the registrar): UNITY_BUILD_BASE_URL has zero hits on main and on the Aura branch — no CDN serving exists. The pre-fix route line `unityAssetIsGzipped(rel) && unityPayloadIsGzip(body)` means a Brotli .unityweb payload receives NO Content-Encoding header and hands raw Brotli bytes to the wasm loader (black canvas). Local harness on the pure modules: 13/13 on the built stage; against the pristine lib it dies at the compression checks (unityPayloadCompression absent). Registrar's re-run: built 16/16 ALL PASS (resolver validation incl. six invalid-base forms -> null; candidate lists with/without the base; dedupe; compression of gzip/brotli/LFS-pointer/plain payloads); pristine fails exactly the two existence legs and exits 1.
steps: With NEXT_PUBLIC_UNITY_BUILD_BASE_URL set to a published build base (e.g. https://<cdn>/builds/<sha>), the player candidate list is [explicit override?, <base>index.html, /unity-client/index.html] — asserted by tests/unity-build-url.test.ts; unset, the list is exactly the pre-PF-10 list.
Serve a Brotli .unityweb through /unity-client/Build/... : the response carries Content-Encoding: br; a gzip payload carries gzip; an LFS pointer 404s; an uncompressed payload carries no encoding.

The world lens mounts the CDN build's index (the iframe then resolves Build/ assets against the CDN origin) — the live leg, gated on Q2's durable-home naming (R2 parked); NOT part of the landed claim.
adversarial: Invalid base values (non-URL, relative, ftp:, credentials, query, hash) resolve to null and never reach the candidate list.
Override identical to the CDN index dedupes to one candidate.
LFS pointer payload: no encoding, route 404 (unchanged from pre-fix).
Uncompressed (plain JS) payload misread as Brotli: excluded by the printable-head test in unityPayloadCompression.
Acceptance attempted with the Q2 gate unmet: the leg refuses by name, never a silent pass; second run / second profile reproduces with no state leaking between profiles.
